Guard [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Zess''' was a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] member of [[Belsavis prison]] guard staff. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] he directed the [[Major/Legends|Major]] of [[Havoc Squad]] to the location of wrongfully imprisoned [[Dagger Wing]] members. After all members of the squadron were accounted for, he arranged for their transit to [[Macula Station]], from where the pilots were able to rejoin the war effort.
